title: The blue line explains a Net term with today's date as the example
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You start a new term due a number of days after the invoice date and read the example the window gives.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Today's date on the calendar of {Location-A} is {Date-A}.
    For example: {Date-A} is Oct 21.
  • {Date-B} is {Date-A} plus 14 days.
    For example: {Date-B} is Nov 4 (Oct 21 + 14 days).
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click "New Credit Term".
  2. Type "Net 14 Days" in Name.
  3. Type 14 in the Days box.
  4. Replace 14 with 0.
  5. Replace 0 with 15.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the "New Credit Term" window opens.
  • Step 2: the Name reads Net 14 Days.
  • Step 3: a blue information line shows below the options: "Net 14 Days means payment is due 14 days after the invoice date. An invoice dated {Date-A} is due {Date-B}." The dates read as a short month and day (for example "Oct 21" and "Nov 4").
  • Step 4: the blue line disappears while the number is invalid.
  • Step 5: the blue line comes back, now ending "is due" {Date-A} plus 15 days (for example Nov 5).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term)

  • S3-R5: “While the chosen box holds a valid number, a blue information line below the options explains the term, using today's date as the example invoice date (S3-R16):”
  • S3-R5, Net line: “Net: "{Name} means payment is due {X} days after the invoice date. An invoice dated {today} is due {due}." For example: "Net 14 Days means payment is due 14 days after the invoice date. An invoice dated Oct 21 is due Nov 4."”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Valid Net term typed | "{Name} means payment is due {X} days after the invoice date. An invoice dated {today} is due {due}." | Blue information line, updates as the user types”
